name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task says that at every moment the ball is out of the way (blocker_moved), the agent must be carrying the key then or pick it up later. Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) hard matches this wording. The rule-only warning is expected because the task has no unconditional goal clause, and the machine's wells correctly penalize leaving blocker_moved with the key not yet obtained.

texts: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door (blocker_moved is true), the agent is carrying the key at that step or later picks it up.
machine:

(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u1
